technical.summary: ACN shows long-term bullish structure (price above 200-EMA, supertrend up) but lacks short-term momentum confirmation (MACD negative, weak ADX, no OBV bullish), making this a weak swing entry with conflicting intermediate signals.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 36 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for ACN; mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 purchases) in small amounts, neutral market fear/greed, and unavailable news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (97.2) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings; earnings in 36 days adds event risk but not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure remains intact (price above 200-EMA, supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) with support at 294.68 providing defined risk entry for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 97.2, strong dollar), zero momentum confirmation (MACD negative, ADX weak at 16.11, no OBV support), no fundamental conviction, and no triggered entry strategies make this a high-risk, low-probability swing setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term structure intact with price above 200-EMA and supertrend bullish, but entry lacks conviction due to absent short-term momentum confirmation and severe macro headwinds that override technical setup.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (97.2), inverted yield curve, and zero MACD/ADX/OBV confirmation create high probability of mean reversion into support before swing target is reached.
